business_dashboard_desc: Your current dashboard follows the selected business. Switching tenants keeps the session active and the shell in sync.
items_desc: Catalog workflows and selling units are ready for the next implementation step.
inventory_desc: Use the active tenant context to scope stock, movements, and replenishment data.
people_desc: Role-aware employee and customer management can build on the same tenant context.
not_implemented: This feature is not yet implemented.
year_on_year_description: The chart compares the current year (2026) with the previous one (2025), showing total performance month by month throughout the year.
vs_previous_month_description: The chart compares {{currentMonth}} (2026) with {{previousMonth}} (2026), divided by weeks.
sales_by_hour_description: Sales distribution across the current day, grouped by hour. Peak hours are highlighted with deeper intensity.
sales_by_day_description: Sales distribution across the current week, grouped by day of the week. Weekend performance is compared against weekdays.
sales_by_date_description: Sales distribution across the current month, grouped by day of the month. Track daily performance trends.
